Summary:
- TightLoop Dialogics runs a programmatic bidding + personalization exchange. Very latency-sensitive: target is <=15ms p95 on the critical reranking path (short context, 128 tokens). Throughput targets: sustained 3k+ QPS on peak campaigns. Cost sensitivity high — they want clear $/million-token comparatives and recommendations to meet p95 SLO without 10x cost blowup.

Technical constraints / preferences:
- Primary model: a distilled transformer reranker (fusion of retrieval + rerank); evaluating open-weights candidates (Llama2-family distill) and a trimmed production model.
- Deploy model behind a low-latency API used in bidding pipeline (sync HTTP call).
- Must live inside customer VPC for production; initial POC can run in Redwood hosted dedicated pool behind VPC peering.
- Data controls: audit logs + KMS for key management; retention policy needs to be configurable. SSO/SAML required for console access.

Optimize interest / asks (explicit):
- Batching: how to safely batch across requests without violating p95 SLOs; want Redwood Optimize recommended batch windows and max batch sizes for 128-token median.
- Caching: interested in prefix/KV caching for repeated user contexts and how cache hit rates map to cost reductions in our traffic shape.
- Quantization: run perf/quality trials for int8 and int4 profiles. Concern: quantization drift on reranker score ordering -> need acceptance criteria (top-5 ranking stable, AUC delta <0.5%).
- Perf benchmarking: ask Redwood to run baseline perf matrix (latency p50/p95/p99, throughput, GPU utilization) across model variants and quant levels. They will provide a JMeter-style harness (internal) but want Redwood to run at scale on dedicated nodes and share raw traces + flamegraphs.

- Quantization: int8 profile acceptable if top-5 rank stability and AUC delta within threshold; int4 evaluated for cost delta but not production-blocking unless quality preserved.
- Cost report: per-million-token cost for each profile and suggested Optimize config (batching window, cache TTLs, quant profile).
